sentence: This project studies how a protein called α-synuclein is modified during normal synaptic activity in the brain.
This project studies how prefrontal cortex circuit function relates to behavior changes after long-term fentanyl self-administration.
This project compares contrast-enhanced ultrasound with cross-sectional imaging for detecting renal cancer that returns after ablation.
This project builds a technology that maps the structure and interactions of the complexes where alternative splicing occurs.
This project tries to find genes and map pathways involved in how cilia are assembled and remodeled.
This project builds a graph-based index of whole genomes from children so researchers can study structural variants linked to pediatric diseases.
This project combines stem cell transplant, base editing and cell therapy to try to eliminate leftover HIV reservoirs.
This project studies the brain circuits in the basal ganglia that control how variable behavior is.
This project tests how DNA methylation levels relate to the development of chronic post-traumatic pain.
This project tries to find small molecules that turn on interferon signaling by disrupting a feedback loop, to boost immune responses against cancer.
This project tests a web-based app that looks for signs of Alzheimer's disease in cognitively healthy elderly people.
This project studies whether a stem cell activation pathway that repairs skeletal muscle stops working in aged muscle and whether restoring it helps.
This project studies which genetic factors change how easily single stranded DNA picks up mutations in yeast and in cancers.
This project uses RNA viruses to study how a chemical mark called 5-methylcytosine on RNA is added and recognized.
This project develops fluorescent proteins and biosensors that resist fading under prolonged illumination so cells can be imaged for longer.
This project tries to find proteins that malaria parasites release in the liver to evade immune responses.
